1: // Game: Neon Runner (endless runner)
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const WIDTH = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
8:   const HEIGHT = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 400;
9: 
10:   // Player circle
11:   const player = {
12:     x: 50,
13:     y: HEIGHT / 2,
14:     radius: 12,
15:     speedY: 0,
16:     maxSpeed: 4,
17:   };
18: 
19:   // Obstacles array
20:   const obstacles = [];
21:   let obstacleSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
22:   let lastSpawn = 0;
23:   let speed = 2; // base horizontal speed of obstacles
24:   let speedIncrease = 0.001; // per ms
25:   let lastTime = 0;
26:   let gameOver = false;
27: 
28:   // Input handling
29:   const keys = {};
30:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
31:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
32: 
33:   function update(dt) {
34:     if (gameOver) return;
35:     // Player vertical movement
36:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w']) player.speedY = -player.maxSpeed;
37:     else if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['s']) player.speedY = player.maxSpeed;
38:     else player.speedY = 0;
39:     player.y += player.speedY;
40:     // Clamp within canvas
41:     if (player.y < player.radius) player.y = player.radius;
42:     if (player.y > HEIGHT - player.radius) player.y = HEIGHT - player.radius;
43: 
44:     // Spawn obstacles
45:     if (Date.now() - lastSpawn > obstacleSpawnInterval) {
46:       const height = 20 + Math.random() * 60;
47:       const gap = 80 + Math.random() * 40; // vertical gap for player to pass
48:       const y = Math.random() * (HEIGHT - height - gap);
49:       obstacles.push({ x: WIDTH, y, w: 20, h: height });
50:       obstacles.push({ x: WIDTH, y: y + height + gap, w: 20, h: HEIGHT - (y + height + gap) });
51:       lastSpawn = Date.now();
52:     }
53: 
54:     // Move obstacles leftward
55:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
56:       const ob = obstacles[i];
57:       ob.x -= speed * dt / 16; // normalize to 60fps base
58:       if (ob.x + ob.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
59:     }
60: 
61:     // Increase speed gradually
62:     speed += speedIncrease * dt;
63: 
64:     // Collision detection (circle vs rectangle)
65:     for (const ob of obstacles) {
66:       const nearestX = Math.max(ob.x, Math.min(player.x, ob.x + ob.w));
67:       const nearestY = Math.max(ob.y, Math.min(player.y, ob.y + ob.h));
68:       const dx = player.x - nearestX;
69:       const dy = player.y - nearestY;

71:         gameOver = true;
72:         break;
73:       }
74:     }
75:   }
